If you or someone you know has been treated for cancer, there's a good chance part of that treatment included radiation. But radiation comes in many forms, and the chances are far less likely that treatment included a medicine that directly delivered some radioactive waste to the tumor. Doctors are already using elements like iodine-131 and lutetium-177 to help treat some cancers, and researchers are investigating elements like actinium-225 to treat even more.

Hosted by: Hank Green (he/him)
